result.summary: Kestrel Marine Parts Ltd has one open overdue invoice (USD 70,000, 38 days past due, notified 2026-10-17 by TCI under policy TCI-EX-2026-0001), with a further USD 95,000 not yet due. The prior overdue (USD 60,000) resolved in 12 days back in July 2026, so both the days-late (12→38) and notification frequency (2 in the last 6-month window vs. 0 before) are increasing from a single policy/insurer. Credit exposure (USD 500,000 limit) remains well above current overdue amounts, but the worsening payment speed warrants closer monitoring.
concerns: Days past due has more than tripled versus the last resolved notification (12 days -> 38 days)
Notification frequency is rising within the 180-day window (0 before vs 2 now) signalling possible onset of payment strain
All exposure concentrated under a single insurer/policy (TCI), limiting cross-validation of buyer behaviour
Further USD 95,000 not-yet-due balance could soon add to the overdue amount if the trend continues
